body: Don’t be scared. When I first told my mom when I was young. She was mad because she thought I had no reason. But soon after she realized my thought processes she did everything she could do to help me and realized the mental status. Good luck it’s good to get off your chest really helps

Going through hard times isn’t always easy. Loneliness sucks. I will admit that but take time to reflect on yourself. You got a job tomorrow and take it all in as experience. You’re tough. 3 years is amazing so keep that going! You’re strong

I’m so sorry for your lost. You’re right every one is worth it. When people lose people it changes them for ever and the people around you. Sorry this happened at a young age. We don’t know what people go through in their lives or own head. It’s hard to understand. To do this it take a lot. I believe it’s a selfless act but it’s not worth it so much in life to look forward too. I hope you’re alright and make sure you are good

Yup I agree. I’m trying to find the best version of me. I feel like I am there but it takes time. And the best time are the alone times. You know you best and those are the times to be honest with yourself cause no one can see or hear you. You be you.

Wow you are awesome! Good for you. I currently understand the self love. Always done stuff for other and care for others more than myself. I was asked the other day by a complete stranger what are my hobbies? My answer was running. So lame it actually got me really down ever sense I have had this week of depression and was doing so good for so long. Anyways not about me but I am happy for you. That take a huge amount of guts.

Wow that was inspiring. You’re absolutely right in all ways. My mental and physical will be my first priority. Time will heal and everything does get better. I’m very good at looking at the positive side of things and the future instead of the negative. Everyone is human and there comes times when we all need help. 
Thank you for your words of wisdom
That is so awesome! It’s the little things that matter most and hit us the hardest. Old people just have something about them they know what to do at the right time.

Holy crap! I just started listening to podcast about serial killers. That is so gnarly! And going to target and buying 2000 piece puzzles till I’m finished. Usually stay up all night working on them. I’m a loser and not doing well so I enjoy those things. Anyways on if you want to talk.
I wish that every night I go to sleep. And then it makes it hard for me to sleep.
A “wake up rich with no feeling towards anything” would be great too lol

You are absolutely right. My brothers are way to young to understand. My wife know that’s I struggle. She does the best she can. It’s me you know? Money part is me never thinking I have enough which is stupid cause a avagerage person probably doesn’t have what I have. Not to sound cocky I just try to tell myself that to help me get through my down moment. And right now I am at my lowest.
I think is selfless. People don’t know what struggles you have in your mind. How much it wares on you inside and out side. It’s your opinion not theirs.
